cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.

mechanism: A uses its pupil old table-setting etiquette to recruit practical participation in hosting a talking cupboard as an ordinary guest.
confusable: Not merely accepting fantasy or issuing absurd orders: A wants B to perform familiar hospitality around the unusual guest until routine takes over.
comparison: Furniture-shaped guest versus invisible guest and competing seating needs.
